Definition: from G4253 and G5525; before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian:--Prochorus.
BiblicalUsage: Prochorus is one of the seven chosen to serve tables in the first church. Luke names him among Stephen and Philip and the rest, men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the seven show that serving tables is apostolic work, and Prochorus is remembered for it.
